name: drenching-finish-class-bonus-on-kill-opponent-mills-three
notes: Drenching Finish (en3DD836cp, WATER WARRIOR/SWORD attack, reserve 2, power 2): "[Class Bonus] On Kill: Target player puts the top three cards of their deck into their graveyard." Player 1's champion is Mordred, Burnished Avenger (a WARRIOR, so the Class Bonus holds). On turn 3 Drenching Finish is played for real and aimed at player 2's Training Dummy (2 life): the 2 damage kills it, the On Kill asks for a target player (the champions are offered) and player 2's champion is chosen: exactly three cards move from the top of player 2's deck to player 2's graveyard.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Kill: Target player puts the top three cards of their deck into their graveyard.
